contents.content: Bangalore blends old and new , and its food options show this mix. Among the many places to eat, Punjabi Dhabas stand out. They offer rich tastes and a one-of-a-kind dining experience. If you want real Punjabi food, you're in luck! This article looks at the best Punjabi Dhabas in Bangalore. It shows off the bold flavors and friendly service these places provide.

What is a Dhaba?

Originally emerged in North India, dhabas are those famous roadside restaurants that serve truck drivers and on-the-go tourists. All of them focus on providing filling, simple meals in a relaxed atmosphere. The atmosphere of a Dhaba is what truly makes it unique, not just the food. The atmosphere has a cozy, nostalgic quality that makes you feel at home.
Dhabas have developed into a lot more than just resting areas in Bangalore. They are now well-liked hangouts for both young people and families. These eateries still offer traditional Punjabi cuisine, but they also have a relaxed vibe .

Top 5 Punjabi Dhabas in Bangalore

1. Chulha Chauki Da Dhaba

Chulha Chauki Da Dhaba also known as CCDD, has made a name for itself in Bangalore for genuine Punjabi food. Since 2009, this Dhaba has become super popular because of its tasty dishes and welcoming atmosphere.

Chulha Chauki Da Dhaba brings the feel of dining by a North Indian highway with its charpais, cane stools, and bamboo partitions. You can choose to eat outdoors or inside at this dhaba where the kitchen churns out delicious food. Skewers of kebabs hang over the tandoor ready to cook. Fill up on tasty gravies and kebabs then drink some lassi to make your stomach happy and content.

Location: Multiple branches across Bangalore, including JP Nagar and Indiranagar.
Price for Two: Approximately ₹1000.

This Dhaba is a little finer than the others, with a special fusion of tasty food and vintage décor. It's a fantastic place for anyone who want to have a lively dining experience.
The most beautiful dhaba on our list is this one. Dhaba Estd 1986 delivers hearty, generously portioned North Indian lip-smackers and has a quirky, retro aesthetic complete with loud Bollywood music. Therefore, we don't mind that they have two restaurants in the city—one each in Marathahalli and Indiranagar. My favorite dishes to eat here are the galouti kebabs and the Tandoori Prawns. Additionally, they have an extensive bar called Theka that serves a variety of dishes, including their distinctive drinks, Imli Bai, Somras, and Laal Pari, which is a dhaba-style Bloody Mary.

Location:107, 1st Floor, Pulikeshi Nagar, Wheeler Road, Cox Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560005.
Price for Two: ₹1,500 (approx.) with alcohol.

4. Maa Da Dhaba

This small dhaba in Yelahanka is definitely worth the drive. Start with appetizers like Anari Paneer Tikka or Chicken Malai Tikka. For the main course, try the Kadhi Pakodi, Vegetable Pulao, Mushroom Matar, and Butter Garlic Naan. We especially recommend the Mushroom Matar.

Location:  791, Yellahanka, New Town Main Rd, Yelahanka Satellite Town, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064
Price for two =₹400 (approx.)

5. Bobby's Dhaba

Bobby's Dhaba is well-known for its warm ambiance and delicious parathas. This Dhaba is ideal for people who want to have a substantial dinner in a laid-back atmosphere.

It's simple to understand why Bobby's Dhaba topped our list—they provide a wide variety of paratha options, including crowd favorites like aloo, onion, paneer, and methi—and serve them with copious amounts of freshly prepared pickle and butter. However, with only four tables, you could be lucky enough to secure a seat at their Yeshwantpur restaurant. Enjoy your buttery parathas with a traditional portion of kadhi chawal, their house-made dal makhani, or rajma masala.

Location:#502, 12th Main MSR Enclave, Yeshwantpur Hobil, near Nagasandra Metro Station, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560073.
Price for Two: Approximately ₹250.

Ambiance and Experience at Dhabas

Eating at a dhaba gives you more than just food; it provides an experience. The basic, country-style setup with wood tables and earth tones creates a snug feel. A lot of dhabas offer outdoor seats too letting you dine beneath the night sky.The mood is often bustling, filled with chuckles and the noise of plates and utensils. This lively environment makes dhabas ideal places to gather with family or hang out with pals.
